capabilities: Chat with local AI CLI agents from a side panel
Attach vault notes and documents to prompts
Inspect streaming reasoning and tool call inputs and outputs
Track sessions, context usage and token cost
extras: Chat history is saved in plain text in the plugin's data.json inside the vault and therefore syncs with synced vaults; persistence can be turned off. Auto-approve and hosted OCR are off by default, and remote media in replies is neutralized.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with local AI CLI agents or hand them vault notes and documents as context.

relations.evidence: Switch between Antigravity (agy), OpenCode (opencode), Hermes Agent (hermes), and Pi (pi)
OpenCode 2.x JSON stream & local DB/API (1.x not supported).
Hermes Agent | hermes | 0.22+ | 0.22.5 | Nous Research CLI (--format stream-json).
Optional PDF, Word, and Excel conversion to Markdown via anydoc (hosted OCR is off by default).
enabling Send documents to hosted OCR uploads scanned files to Firecrawl Parse (off by default).

summary: Chat panel that connects local AI CLI agents (Antigravity, OpenCode, Hermes, Pi) to a vault, with note attachments and tool-call inspection.
